hero.title: Welcome to Your Creative Command Center
hero.subtitle: Moodboard Manager is your all-in-one visual workspace for bringing characters and stories to life. Whether you're crafting graphic novels, designing character concepts, or writing comic scripts, everything you need is right here—organized, offline-ready, and synced across your devices.

step1.title: Create Your First Project
step1.description: Click 'New Project' on the home screen. You can quick capture an idea with just a description, or do a full setup with name and tags.
step1.tip: Wake up with an idea? Write it down, so you don't lose it. You can add a proper name later!

step2.title: Add Characters
step2.description: Characters are the heart of your project. Add name, age, role, personality traits, and upload reference images for visual inspiration.
step2.tip: Add custom fields for anything you need: 'Weapon', 'Catchphrase', 'Home Planet'—you name it!

step3.title: Start Creating
step3.description: Jump into Grid View for a gallery of references, Canvas Mode for an infinite visual workspace, or Editions to write your comic script.
step3.tip: Use Canvas mode to create mood sheets for specific scenes or chapters!

projects.title: Project Management
projects.description: Quick capture ideas or create full projects with metadata. Archive old projects, export as ZIP files, and organize with tags and filters. Edit project details anytime as your ideas evolve.

characters.title: Character Profiles
characters.description: Deep dive into every character with profiles, visual references, custom fields, and unlimited images. Each character gets their own dedicated space with personality traits, backstory, and more.

canvas.title: Visual Moodboard Canvas
canvas.description: Infinite workspace for visual storytelling. Drag & drop images, arrange freely, zoom & pan, lock items, and auto-extract color palettes. Think of it as your digital corkboard—but way better.

scripts.title: Comic Book Scripts
scripts.description: Write your comic panel-by-panel with the Editions feature. Organize by issues/volumes, break into pages, and script each panel with visual descriptions, camera angles, character dialogues, and SFX.

storage.title: Storage & Backup
storage.description: Local storage with OPFS for lightning-fast access. Full backup/restore via ZIP export. Storage monitor shows exactly how much space you're using. Your data stays safe offline.

sync.title: Google Drive Auto-Sync
sync.description: Ultimate backup solution—sync projects, characters, scripts, and images across all devices. Work offline, sync when back online. Conflict resolution built-in for safe merging.

i18n.title: Multi-Language Support
i18n.description: Switch between English and Portuguese (pt-BR) anytime in Settings. All features fully translated—UI, scripts, errors. Changes apply instantly without reload.

pwa.title: Progressive Web App
pwa.description: Install as a native app for faster load times, full offline functionality, and standalone window. Works on desktop and mobile with zero app store hassle.

characterDesign.title: Character Design Project
characterDesign.step1: Create new project: 'My Comic - Character Designs'
characterDesign.step3: Upload reference images (costume sketches, pose studies)
characterDesign.step4: Switch to Canvas mode and arrange costume refs on left, poses on right
characterDesign.step5: Export when ready for artist handoff

quickCapture.title: Quick Idea Capture → Full Project
quickCapture.step1: Wake up with story idea, click 'New Project'
quickCapture.step2: Skip name, type idea in description
quickCapture.step4: Later: Edit project details, add proper name
quickCapture.step5: Develop into full project with characters and script

comicScript.title: Writing a Comic Script
comicScript.step3: Go to Editions tab → New Edition, set up 24 pages
comicScript.step4: Add panels page-by-page with visual descriptions
comicScript.step5: Write dialogue with character links and share via Export

crossDevice.title: Cross-Device Collaboration
crossDevice.step1: Enable Google Drive Sync on Desktop
crossDevice.step3: Open app on tablet and sign in to same Google account
crossDevice.step5: Make edits on tablet, view updates on desktop after sync

quickCapture.title: Quick Capture Workflow
quickCapture.description: Ideas strike anytime—open app, new project, type description, done in 10 seconds. No pressure naming! Let ideas mature before committing to a name. All project details are editable later.

imageManagement.title: Image Management
imageManagement.description: Bulk upload multiple files at once—we handle WebP conversion automatically. Tag images with keywords like 'reference', 'final', 'inspiration'. Thumbnails are auto-generated.

canvasOrganization.title: Canvas Organization
canvasOrganization.description: Use pinch-to-zoom on touch devices, scroll wheel on desktop. Lock background images so you don't accidentally move them. Use 'Bring to Front' to create visual hierarchy.

scriptWriting.title: Script Writing
scriptWriting.description: Set a clear goal for each page—keeps your story tight. Link dialogues to character profiles for consistency. Use notes field liberally for artist direction.

sync.title: Sync Issues
sync.solution: Check internet connection, re-authenticate Google Drive in Settings → Cloud Sync, or check browser console for detailed errors.

storage.title: Storage Issues
storage.solution: Export project as ZIP, delete unused projects/images, or enable Google Drive sync to offload local storage.

images.title: Image Upload Issues
images.solution: Check file format (JPG, PNG, WEBP supported), verify file size is under ~50MB, and check browser console for errors.

performance.title: Canvas Performance
performance.problem: Canvas is laggy with many images
performance.solution: Reduce number of images on canvas, lock items you're not actively moving, or reload page to clear memory.

cta.title: You're Ready!
cta.description: You now have everything you need to organize visual references, build character profiles, write comic scripts, and sync across all your devices. Start creating—your story is waiting!
